stem:
The figure shows a cell, a lamp, and a switch S. The switch is open, so its contacts do not touch.

Is the circuit ON or OFF?

options.text: OFF — the open switch breaks the path, so current cannot flow.
ON — the cell still sends current across the open gap.
ON — the switch itself supplies current to the lamp.
OFF — a lamp cannot glow unless two switches are used.

teacher.key_rationale: An open switch leaves a gap, so the circuit is OFF and the lamp stays dark.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source circuit to a cell–lamp–open-switch loop matching the ON/OFF hinge.
